vb_textbox.text: More often, I found that the brown long hat gnome was the one which consistently produced good rewards. I stuck to the brown one, until the rewards dwindled down, when I would swap to the pink one instead until its rewards dwindled down. For the purple/greyblue pair, I found that the one on the right led to more rewards for me, but I would just keep pressing until it stopped giving rewards too. In general, if the one you pressed in the previous trial yielded 2 or less, in the next one, try the other one.
